environment: Docker on WSL2; shared host resources
metric: maximum observed process-wide RSS during operation; not operation-attributed peak memory
limitations: single Docker-on-WSL2 process and shared host; no independent-runner reproduction
RSS is process-wide, includes JVM/native allocations and is not attributable to a single operation
50 ms sampling may miss short-lived peaks; sample counts vary by operation duration
spill bytes are not emitted by this graph-comparison profile
separate sampled timings are not comparable with clean timing runs
diagnostic only; no capacity guarantee or accepted regression threshold
